feature_schema.categorical_input: zipcode: five-character string; unseen categories are ignored by the encoder
feature_schema.numeric_input: finite floats or np.nan; no infinity
feature_schema.missing_policy: median imputation with missing indicators, learned only within the fitted pipeline
feature_schema.age_policy: valuation year minus audited built/renovation year; future years masked to NaN
feature_schema.renovation_policy: was_renovated = 0 for recorded year 0; years_since_renovation=NaN then; unknown year remains NaN

limitations: Historical King County transactions from 2014-2015; not a current-market valuation.
Full-file EDA and KPI inspection occurred before this modeling split.
Chronological split permits property-ID overlap; not an ID-disjoint benchmark.
Historical feature availability at listing time is not established by the source.
Age features assume a known valuation date; use the same definition at prediction time.
Price-segment and importance diagnostics are descriptive, not causal or uncertainty intervals.
Fixed initial candidates; no claim of optimal hyperparameters or production readiness.
